packageRules.description: Focused rollout: Renovate owns only the CLI's Go modules (the Bluelink dependency chain — libs/blueprint, blueprint-state, common, deploy-engine-client, and the sibling deploy-cli-sdk). The Rust/Node/Python runtime ecosystems stay on Dependabot for now, so `includePaths` keeps Renovate out of them. The bluelink-consumers preset supplies the cascade rule that auto-merges internal github.com/newstack-cloud/* bumps and bypasses the weekly schedule.
